# go-build-cache

Go's compiled build cache. Go rebuilds what it needs.

**Name:** Go build cache · **Category:** Package caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://pkg.go.dev/cmd/go#hdr-Build_and_test_caching>

**Detected when** one of `go` is on PATH or one of `{cache}` exists.

## Paths

Resolved in this order: the tool's own command, then the environment variable, then the system default.

- `{cache}`: `go env GOCACHE` → `$GOCACHE` → macOS `~/Library/Caches/go-build` → Linux `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/go-build` → Windows `%LOCALAPPDATA%/go-build`

## Locations

| Path | Item | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{cache}` | Go build cache | Safe | Your build tools recreate this automatically (`REGENERABLE`) | `native:go-clean-cache`, `quarantine` |

## Native commands

- `native:go-clean-cache` runs `go clean -cache` (timeout 600 s, freed space measured before and after)
